Quick spectral looks at three omics layers:

1. serum metabolites – eigen-decomposition of the covariance matrix;
2. placenta CpGs (GSE71678) – SVD of the standardised beta matrix;
3. placenta miRNA and arsenic (GSE48355) – SVD vs PCA.

Sources: `EnvBRAN/eigen_svd.jl`, `EnvBRAN/Untitled.ipynb` (CpG SVD),
`EnvBRAN/As_miRNA.ipynb` (24 MB of stored outputs; only the 18 code cells
were kept).

```{julia}
using ExposomicsJulia
using DataFrames, Statistics, LinearAlgebra, Plots, CSV, HTTP, JSON
using MultivariateStats
using Arrow
DATA = joinpath(pkgdir(ExposomicsJulia), ".data")
```

## Serum metabolites: eigenvalues of the covariance matrix

The JSON was read from `https://provanik.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/data_serum.json`
(no longer available); place a copy in `.data/serum/data_serum.json`.

```{julia}
#| eval: false
jobj = JSON.parsefile(joinpath(DATA, "serum", "data_serum.json"))
serum_sample = vcat(DataFrame.(jobj["serum_sample"])..., cols = :union);
X = permutedims(Matrix{Float64}(serum_sample[:, 1:1198]))

# covariance by hand (cov(X))
X = X .- mean(X, dims = 1)
Y = (X' * X) ./ (size(X, 1) - 1)

eig_Y = eigen(Symmetric(Y));
eig_expl = sort(eig_Y.values / sum(eig_Y.values), rev = true)
bar(eig_expl, xlabel = "Components", ylabel = "% var explained",
    title = "Eigen serum metabolites", label = "")
```

## Placenta CpGs (GSE71678)

```{julia}
#| eval: false
cpgs = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "GSE71678", "GSE71678_cpgs_original.arrow")));
matcpgs = rescale(permutedims(Matrix{Float64}(cpgs[:, 2:end])); dims = 1);
svdcpgs = svd(matcpgs);
100 * svdcpgs.S / sum(svdcpgs.S)
scatter(svdcpgs.U[:, 1], svdcpgs.U[:, 2], title = "SVD", label = "",
        markersize = 3, markerstrokewidth = 0)
```

## Placenta miRNA and arsenic (GSE48355)

Birth-weight z-scores from an external reference table (`bw.csv`, mean and
SD by sex and completed gestational week).

```{julia}
#| eval: false
df = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "GSE48355", "GSE48355_cov_original.arrow")));
rename!(df, [:ID, :smk, :gestage, :bw_g, :sex, :tissue, :UAs_spg, :DAs, :species, :mage])
bw = CSV.read(joinpath(DATA, "GSE48355", "bw.csv"), DataFrame);
bw.compl_gestage_w = Float64.(bw.compl_gestage_w)
DT = innerjoin(df, bw, on = [:sex => :sex, :gestage => :compl_gestage_w])
DT.bw_zscore = (DT.bw_g .- DT.mean) ./ DT.std;
```

```{julia}
#| eval: false
miRNA = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "GSE48355", "GSE48355_miRNA.arrow")));
miRNA = miRNA[:, intersect(names(miRNA), vcat("ID_REF", DT.ID))];
matRNA = rescale(Matrix{Float64}(miRNA[:, 2:end]); dims = 1);

svdRNA = svd(matRNA);
svdRNA.S ./ sum(svdRNA.S)
pcaRNA = fit(PCA, matRNA; maxoutdim = 2)
```

```{julia}
#| eval: false
scatter(svdRNA.U[:, 1], svdRNA.U[:, 2], mc = PALETTE[1], label = "SVD",
        markersize = 3, markerstrokewidth = 0)
scatter!(-projection(pcaRNA)[:, 1], -projection(pcaRNA)[:, 2], mc = PALETTE[2], label = "PCA",
         markersize = 3, markerstrokewidth = 0)
```
